description: This file defines the SaveCandidateController class, which handles candidate save operations and permission checks within the recruitment module of the OrangeHRM system. It manages pre-render data preparation for candidate profile views and access control logic based on user roles and candidate existence.

classes.name: SaveCandidateController
classes.description: Controller for managing candidate save operations, including permission checks and preparing data for candidate profile views within the recruitment module.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with necessary properties based on whether a candidate ID is provided; handles permission checks and sets component properties accordingly.

methods.name: isCapable
methods.description: Checks whether the current user has permission to access or create candidate data, based on candidate existence and user role permissions.
